senses.gloss: m. (= טְפִיחַ I, v. טְפֵי II) [dripper,] vessel with a narrow neck.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:3">Kel. II, 3</cite> <he>ט׳ שהתקינו לענבים</he> a pitcher which was made with the intention of using it for grapes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 12:5">Neg. XII, 5</cite> <he>טָפְיוֹ</he> (R. S. a. l. <he>תָּפְיוֹ</he>) man’s oil vessels.
